wire.headline: Celtic Homes Launches Emergency Restructuring Amid Financial Crisis
sentences: Celtic Homes has announced an emergency restructuring plan valued at 310m GBP.
The board voted 5-2 to approve the immediate sale of assets.
CEO Marian Holt attributed the decision to a 12% revenue decline in the last quarter.
Shares fell as the company's market cap dropped to 4.26bn GBP overnight.
A total of 4,800 staff roles are at risk across three regions.
The restructuring measures will be effective from 4 November onwards.
A debt refinancing deadline has been set for March 2027.
The insolvent subsidiary Meridian Estates is scheduled to be liquidated.
